name: Triumph of the Will
body:
Your powerful rhetoric and subtle implications of lurking danger drive others into a panicked yet lasting faith in you as the one they can trust.

Prerequisite(s): Persuasive, Intimidate 5 ranks, Cha 13+

Benefit(s): When you use Intimidate to force a single creature to act friendly toward you, the effect lasts for 1d6 hours, plus one hour for every point by which your Intimidate check exceeds the DC. Alternatively, you can attempt to force a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier to act friendly toward you for 1d6 minutes plus one minute for every point by which your Intimidate check exceeds the DC. You make a single check against the highest Intimidate DC (10 + Hit Dice + Wisdom modifier) among your targets, increasing the DC by 2 for each creature after the first. All creatures to be affected must be within 30 feet

Legendary Classes: Defenders of the Faith © 2024, Legendary Games; Jason Nelson, Aaron Hollingsworth, Amber Scott, Andrew J. Gibson, Carl Cramer, Clinton J. Boomer, Connor Bates, Jenny Jarzabski, Margherita Tramontano, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke, and Norman Mitchell Jr.
